name: Janet Michael
missingPieces: In-platform Tasks 3, 7, and 10 were not submitted; capstone D2 omitted Artefact 04.
feedback: Only Task 6 was available in the in-platform write-ups, so Tasks 3, 7, and 10 could not receive credit there. The Task 6 answer correctly identifies bcrypt, MD5, SHA-256, and Argon2id and ranks rotation urgency sensibly, but it needed direct standard citations with section numbers for full credit. Your capstone does better: D1 explains the AES key and IV exposure, static IV use, HS256 risk, and three JWT failures, while D2 correctly recovers the AES plaintext, ROT13 message, JWT table, and layered memo. The major capstone gap is that Artefact 04 is missing from D2, so you did not prove the captured token was tampered, recover the leaked source secret, or forge the expected amaka.eze token. D3 and D4 are useful and practical, but the controls should map more consistently to at least two findings each and the ethics stance should cite the ISC2 canon more precisely.
